text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Regarding appearing on the stream you two 
host, has the topic been decided yet?

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. I'm still thinking about it, but I 
figured everyone would love hearing 
stories about America!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... There are so many different topics 
when it comes to America. What kind of 
content are the viewers looking for?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's see. First off, I don't think we can 
skip talking about the race.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"Good! That's an absolute must, of course. 
I don't mind spending an hour or two on 
it! From the American Triple Crown to the 
Breeders' Cup!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. That sounds fun too, but I'd love to 
hear all sorts of other stories as well♪ 
Like the history of the towns around the 
racetracks, or how the locals live.

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"I think I'd love to know about photogenic 
spots for streams and gourmet info! Stuff 
that might come in handy for a travel 
stream someday!"

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
"I see... So you seek a deeper 
'understanding' of America."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ After all, to deliver "love," you 
need to know everything about the other 
person.

text_block_list.name: Casino Drive
text_block_list.text:
Excellent...! Sure thing. From the town's 
history and cultural customs to local 
cuisine not meant for tourists, I can talk 
for three hours!

text_block_list.name: Marche Lorraine
text_block_list.text:
"A single stream slot won't be nearly 
enough~!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ Looks like it's going to be a very 
fun stream!
